messages:
marta: Quick idea — I'm thinking of making a tiny 'playground' starter: Next.js + Tailwind + Redwood SDK + LlamaClient + a minimal eval harness to demonstrate onboarding flow and SDK parity. I can sketch a prototype if someone wants to review.

arjun: Love it. Can we make the auth pattern explicit? dev onboarding always trips over env vs browser API keys.

jess: +1. Suggestion: use an edge API route for the SDK key proxy so the client never sees raw keys, and include a simple .env.example.

marta: Yep planning that. Prototype will include an /api/session route that exchanges a short-lived token. Also show the alternate "self-hosted token" path for Private customers.

ben: Also add a small LangChain example (chains + retriever) and a LlamaIndex notebook snippet. People expect both. Keep them tiny — just 1 file each.

sara: For retries: the SDK has built-in 429/backoff behavior, but the sample should demonstrate idempotency keys and a client-side exponential retry helper. Otherwise folks copy/paste naive loops.

oli: For the eval harness: include a fixtures/ prompts.json and a deterministic runner that seeds RNGs and records outputs. Show how to run with CI and save an artifacts JSON.

marta: Good call. Plan: tests/eval-runner.js that runs 3 prompts and creates artifacts/eval-<sha>.json. Include a tiny diff-checker to catch regressions.

jess: Can we include commands and a sample .env? That always helps.

marta: Adding now. Example: 

```
# .env.example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redwood_test_abc123
NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAYGROUND=true
LLAMA_ENDPOINT=https://inference.example.com/v1/generate
```

marta: And a sample run: `npm run dev` and `npm run eval -- --rebuild` in README.

arjun: For the Next.js pieces, make sure SSR example shows token handling for server-side render vs client streaming. A one-file demo in /pages/ssr-demo.js would be great.

ben: For the LangChain part, include a short snippet in docs: 

```js
const chain = new LLMChain({ llm: new RedwoodLLM({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY }) });
await chain.call({ input: 'summarize: ' + text });
```

ben: Keep it conceptual, link to official SDK for full usage.

sara: Also add a Troubleshooting section about common auth/retry pitfalls: 401 vs 403, clock skew for signed tokens, and when to use idempotency.

oli: CI idea: GH Action that runs eval-runner and uploads artifact to a branch folder. If diff > threshold, post a PR comment. Keep config minimal so folks can copy it.

marta: I'll open a draft PR in the repo after lunch. Asking for reviewers: @arjun @jess @ben for technical bits, @sara for retries/auth docs.

dev-bot: CI check queued for branch 'marta/quickplay' — build started. (:rocket:)

arjun: Quick note — can we add a small section showing how to toggle between hosted vs dedicated endpoints? People ask about model variants and routing.

marta: Good call. I'll add a short table and example config in next.config.js with `REDACTED_ROUTING` env toggles.

jess: Love this. If you want I can help wire up the Tailwind and a couple of UI components.

marta: Thanks! Will ping when PR is up.

oli: Also include a tiny perf note: show token/time breakdown in console logs so devs can see how batching/caching cuts cost.

marta: Will include a short section in README: `how to read token/latency logs` + link to /docs/perf.

dev-bot: CI build 1224 passed tests for branch 'marta/quickplay' — artifacts uploaded.

marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/playgrounds/pull/42 — draft. Please review when you can, especially the eval harness logic.

ben: Reviewing now. Quick scan looks good. Small nit: rename `eval-runner` -> `eval-check` to imply CI gating.

sara: Approved for retries/docs bits, left one inline comment about idempotency header example.

jess: Will add UI polish in a follow-up PR.

marta: Thanks team! Planning to merge next Tues if no blockers.

oli: Nice work — this will help our onboarding demos a lot. :tada:
